findings.subject: Five selection operations
findings.evidence: All five changed loops collect native PoseBone/legacy Bone selection owners with the shared product helper, then set the active bone before writing exact final selected flags. Modern Pose selection is per-object and does not write shared Bone selection; unknown API owner and write failures propagate.

findings.subject: Read-only Pose visibility
findings.evidence: New session._pose_hidden prioritizes actual PoseBone.hide, otherwise reads actual Bone.hide. The return must be bool, missing/invalid APIs fail, no selection/visibility property is manufactured or changed. All five changed candidate filters call this helper while retaining original hide_select/rotation-lock/scope checks.

findings.subject: Compatibility caller shape
findings.evidence: session._show_control retains its three positional arguments and adds an optional keyword-only backend. Internal session callers supply the current native backend; the existing Raise caller resolves character_designer.animation_composition lazily. The helper preflights all owners before selection/active mutation.

Full current/visual_guard/checkpoint_state/reference receipt/source-cache protection, Raise _row_anchor/_fresh_row/run, timing _row/_open/_sealed_loop/_sealed_raise/_published_hold/_numeric_proof and existing clocks/native fingerprints/export guards are unchanged.
